_doc: Declared race corridors (ledger 0049; replaces the 0047 centre chain). Index = vertex of data/centerline.local.json (engine frame x=E, y=up, z=N; same count as gate_centerline.json; the last entry repeats vertex 0). y = metres LEFT of the increasing-vertex tangent (left normal (-tz, tx) of the central difference). edge_strip_by_vertex: 1 everywhere — both curb strips are closed loops (no bridge gaps); band centre at +-(half_w + params.edge_centre_from_lip_m) EXCEPT at edge_corners (the strip trimmed to the curb's corner: in_vertex band point -> xz -> out_vertex, the `removed` vertices carry none). centre_w_by_vertex: all 0 (the chain is retired; removed in v3). kerbs: the race kerbs as swept (i/j after race.kerbs.trims and the closure clip; trimmed_from / clipped_from record the detector's run); kerbs_dropped: detected kerbs race.kerbs.trims drops, each with its why (nothing is authored there). corridors.<layout id>: that layout's closure (closure_y_by_vertex = the strip CENTRE lateral, null where none stands; pins included), its lane faces (lane_by_vertex [y_lo, y_hi], forward frame), zones (whole | box | pin | closure | island), runs, mouth policies and the no_route probes. Written by tools/barrier_bands.py; consumed by tools/race_furniture.py, scripts/geometry/median_zone.py, scripts/geometry/drive_test.py, scripts/geometry/audit_mesh.py, tools/no_route.py, scripts/ac/write_ai_line.py.

kerb_trims.why: Hairpin inside kerb (installed since 0047 at v751-775): 13 of its 139 stations sat under the other sheet of the hairpin's ribbon fold - v764 by up to 0.04 m, v774 by up to 0.14 m (the installed race_authored.json lists 0.166 m of other deck above it at v774). v751-763 is one sheet throughout: 111 stations, a 26 m kerb on the entry that stops 4 m short of the old trimmed corner; the 4 m exit leg (v774-775) goes.

College/Navajo inside apex: only 18 of the kerb's 34 stations sit on one sheet - about 1.5 m at each end (v1508-1509, v1518-1519); at v1517-1518 13 stations sit under the fold's upper sheet (up to 0.05 m) and 4 verts stand +0.13 m over the lower one (race audit K 158 vs the installed 154). No single-sheet stretch of useful length reaches the apex: dropped until the ribbon fold is one sheet.

Navajo/Jackson inside apex (race_cw's AI line apexes 1.5 m off it): the ribbon folds into two sheets up to 0.46 m apart at v2315 and v2323-2324, and 8 of the kerb's 51 stations sit under the upper sheet by up to 0.42 m - a red/white kerb vanishing under the asphalt at the apex. The single-sheet pieces are 4.5 m on entry (v2313-2314) and about 5 m on exit (v2324-2326), neither at the apex: dropped until the ribbon fold is one sheet.
